jobs.title: Staff Pharmacist - Full-Time (On site, Port Coquitlam, BC)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
📍Located near Fremont Connector and Sherling Avenue 

Why Join Us

Felix Pharmacy is proud to be a fully Canadian-owned and operated mail-order pharmacy, located in Port Coquitlam, British Columbia. Our model is built around a strong focus on delivering safe, efficient, and patient-centred care.

Here’s what makes us different: 

  • 🏡Local roots, national impact - you’ll be a part of a team that’s helping patients across Canada while staying grounded in a close-knit, Port Coquitlam-based operation. 

  • 📦Focused work environment - Our mail-order model is designed for accuracy and efficiency, allowing you to focus on patient care in a calm, well-structured environment.

  • 👥People-first workplace - We prioritize teamwork, open communication, and a shared commitment to doing great work.

  • ⏰ Predictable, steady schedule - Enjoy a consistent work routine with scheduled shifts set in advance

  • 🌟 Employee benefits – We support your well-being with a comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and other coverage options.

What You’ll Do 

  • Accurately and safely fill prescriptions using established workflow procedures.

  • Counsel patients on new therapies, ensuring understanding and comfort with their medications.

  • Monitor patient adherence and provide ongoing medication consultations.

  • Maintain patient profiles and records in accordance with all privacy and regulatory standards.

  • Collaborate closely with a team of pharmacists, technicians, and other pharmacy staff to support smooth, efficient daily operations. 

  • Ensure full compliance with all regulations set by NAPRA and the College of Pharmacists of British Columbia.

  • Flexibility to support shift coverage on short notice is considered an asset.

What We’re Looking For

  • Licensing: Part A licensed by the College of Pharmacists of British Columbia, in good standing. 

  • Experience: Minimum 2 years of pharmacy experience; mail-order or high volume setting preferred.

  • Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Kroll and general pharmacy IT systems. 

  • Detail-Oriented: Accuracy in prescription preparation, labelling, and documentation is essential.

  • Team Player: Self-motivated and able to work independently or collaboratively with the team.

  • Strong Communicator: Excelled in verbal and written communication skills.


Perks & Benefits

  • Medical, dental and vision benefits

  • Wellness spend

  • Paid sick days

  • Competitive compensation

  • Casual Dress

  • On-Site Parking

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Felix

Felix is Canada's first end-to-end platform providing on-demand treatment for everyday health. Felix creates digital-first solutions that increase access for common healthcare needs such as sexual health, weight loss, testing and diagnostics, and more. Founded in 2019, Felix's approach to healthcare encompasses assessments, prescriptions, fast and discreet delivery, and ongoing healthcare support, all online.

Felix has delivered 24 quarters of consecutive growth in both revenue and profit, making it one of Canada's fastest growing tech companies. But more importantly, over 1 million Canadians (and counting!) trust Felix for their everyday healthcare needs.


About the role

At Felix, we believe that good creative is at the core of achieving our mission. By demystifying complexity, removing stigma, and increasing access, we can deliver care that truly puts patients first.

You'll be joining a tight-knit team of creatives who collaborate closely to create a beautiful and cohesive experience for patients throughout their journey. This role sits at the centre of our performance creative engine, where the goal is not a single hero asset but a steady, high-volume flow of ideas tested in market.

You Will

  • Run the day-to-day flow of production, orchestrating weekly project plans and daily schedules so every deliverable moves from ideation to launch on time, and keeping enough creative volume in motion each sprint to give winning ads room to emerge.

  • Own concept and output review: perform first-level QC on scripts, edits, pacing, story flow, and visual issues, coordinate quick turnarounds with editors and creators, and make sure every deliverable meets the brief, brand guidelines, and ad platform specs.

  • Manage and grow Felix's creator bench: recruit, onboard, and coordinate creators and UGC talent, run a fast feedback loop of weekly calls and quick script turnarounds, and maintain a raw-footage and asset library for reuse and AI-assisted remixing.

  • Own supplier and talent relationships: negotiate rates, issue SOWs, and manage creators, actors, photographers, videographers, and production assistants, keeping a vetted roster complete with rate cards, availability, and specialties.

  • Manage the production budget and support forecasting across creators, locations, and vendors, flagging where consolidating or renegotiating vendor terms creates efficiency.

  • Work closely with the Associate Creative Director, Growth team, and strategists to turn the creative calendar into realistic production plans, giving clear input on capacity, timelines, and feasibility.

  • Translate creative briefs into clear shot lists, call sheets, timelines, and deliverable checklists across a native, lo-fi, creator-first register as well as polished production.

  • Source locations, props, and wardrobe as needed, and oversee production days when required.

  • Own the compliance gate for production outputs: secure all usage rights, model releases, and documentation before production begins, and enforce Canadian health-advertising requirements, including no before and after imagery, no efficacy or outcome claims, and no naming a medication next to a condition.

  • Feed production learnings back to the creative team: tag deliverables to their concept, run post-shoot feedback loops, and flag what is and isn't landing so the team can iterate.

  • Build scalable systems, workflows, and documentation that increase creative output without increasing complexity, identifying where bottlenecks cost the team time or money.

You have

  • Has 5+ years in creative project management, production, or operations, including experience managing a production budget.

  • Has a proven track record of improving creative processes in a growth-stage environment, and can point to specific process or efficiency gains they have driven.

  • Has built or run a creator, UGC, or content pipeline at volume, and is comfortable operating in a native, lo-fi, creator-first register, not only polished production.

  • Uses AI fluently in production, both to test creative directions cheaply and to remix and version assets at scale.

  • Has experience in the performance marketing industry.

  • Has experience mentoring or informally leading junior team members or freelance production talent.

  • Is extremely organized and can manage a variety of creative requests and deliverables from a wide range of creative partners and stakeholders.

  • Has strong project management skills and is an exceptional communicator, comfortable representing production in cross-functional conversations.

  • Maintains strict adherence to industry regulations and legal requirements, ideally including health or other regulated advertising.

  • Is a self-starter who can juggle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Obsesses over details and has a passion for continuously optimizing production processes.

  • Is kind and empathetic, and excited about Felix's mission of making everyday healthcare accessible and stigma-free for Canadians.

Benefits:

  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits

  • Maternity/paternity policy

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Felix

Founded in 2019, Felix is a digital healthcare company that puts the patient in control of their own health and well-being. We’re passionate about building technology and beautiful customer experiences to make healthcare more accessible (and more enjoyable) for all Canadians.

Felix is Canada's first end-to-end healthcare experience, providing online treatment, prescription delivery and ongoing care. We deliver care across a growing range of daily health categories such as weight loss, birth control, menopause, erectile dysfunction, acne, longevity and more.

Website: https://www.felixforyou.ca/

 

The Role

Felix is hiring an HR Business Partner (HRBP) to support all frontline operations across our network. Our current sites are in Mississauga, ON, Richmond Hill, ON and Port Coquitlam, BC.

You’ll be the dedicated HR Business Partner for our pharmacy and fulfillment teams, the people who get care to patients’ doors. You’ll own employee relations, policy and employee experience across our sites, and help shape how we support new locations as we grow. The role is hybrid, with up to 3 days a week on-site in Mississauga and Richmond Hill and periodic travel to Port Coquitlam, BC (as per business needs).

You’ll report directly to our VP, HR, with a seat close to the people's decisions shaping the company, and partner day-to-day with our Pharmacy Operations leaders and the wider HR and Talent teams.

 

Key Responsibilities

Employee Relations and HR Support

  • Be the go-to HR partner for employees and managers across our pharmacy and fulfillment teams. You’ll build trust in person in Mississauga and Richmond Hill, and through virtual partnership and visits in Port Coquitlam and the new sites we open.

  • Coach and develop our site leaders, many of them growing into management for the first time, on performance, development and the everyday people decisions that shape their teams.

  • Own employee relations end to end, from investigations and conflict resolution to performance improvement plans and terminations, handling each case with sound judgment, fairness and clear documentation.


HR Policies and Compliance

  • Build and evolve our HR policies: spot the gaps, design practical solutions, and roll them out consistently across every site so the experience feels fair, whether you’re in Mississauga or Port Coquitlam.

  • Keep us compliant across provinces, applying Ontario and BC employment legislation day to day and helping us expand confidently into new provinces as we grow.

  • Learn and navigate the pharmacy-specific landscape, including provincial College requirements around licensure and scope of practice. Healthcare experience helps, but we’ll support you in getting up to speed.

  • Champion workplace health and safety as a member of each site’s Joint Health and Safety Committee (JHSC), partnering with our Health Compliance team on fulfillment-specific priorities like ergonomics, material handling and equipment training.


HR Operations and Team Partnership

  • Run smooth people operations with our HR and Pharmacy Operations teams, covering onboarding, offboarding, benefits and employee data, and keeping our HiBob records accurate and audit-ready.

  • Bring our people programs to life for our pharmacy and fulfillment teams, from performance reviews and engagement surveys to compensation cycles, adapting them to work for a shift-based workforce.

  • Partner with your fellow HRBPs to keep policies, programs and the employee experience consistent across the business and across provinces.

  • Support hiring alongside our Talent team as we staff up existing sites and open new ones.


What you’ll bring

  • Scale-up HR experience: you’ve provided hands-on HR support in a fast-growing company, ideally for a diverse workforce that mixes full-time, part-time and casual employees.

  • 5+ years of progressive HR experience, with real ownership of a client group or site.

  • Solid knowledge of Ontario and BC employment law, including the ESA, OHSA and WorkSafeBC, and the Human Rights Codes, plus health and safety in a warehouse or fulfillment setting. You’re comfortable getting up to speed on new provinces as we expand.

  • A track record with complex employee relations: you handle sensitive cases with discretion and sound judgment, and you document them thoroughly.

  • Comfort with modern HR tools. HiBob and Ashby are a plus, but any comparable HRIS and ATS will do.

  • Real care for the details: you take pride in getting contracts, compliance documentation and employee data right, because you know that in a regulated healthcare environment it matters.


Nice to have

  • Experience supporting pharmacy or other regulated healthcare teams. If that’s new to you, that’s okay. We’ll help you get up to speed on College requirements and scope of practice.


Benefits

  • Direct access to leadership: you’ll work closely with our VP, HR and senior leaders, with real influence over how we grow our people function.

  • Impact you can see: you’ll shape the employee experience for the teams who get care to patients across Canada, at a fast-growing healthcare brand with a real physical operation.

  • 4 weeks of vacation: 3 weeks to take whenever you like, plus an extra week off over the holidays.

  • Full health coverage, including medical, dental and vision benefits from day one.

  • Parental leave for new parents.

  • Hybrid flexibility, with up to 3 days a week on-site in Mississauga

About Felix:

Felix is Canada’s first end-to-end platform providing on-demand treatment for everyday health. Felix creates digital-first solutions that increase access for common healthcare needs such as mental health, sexual health, and daily health. Founded in 2019, Felix’s approach to healthcare encompasses assessments, lab testing, prescriptions, fast and discreet delivery, and ongoing care — all online at www.felixforyou.ca.

The Role

As our medical office administrator, you will be a key member of the clinical operations team, working cross-functionally with our medical directors, clinical operations team, medical office administration team, and customer support team. You will be principally responsible for assisting in the day-to-day clinical support and administration of our network of healthcare practitioners, maintaining exceptional quality of care, patient confidentiality, and promoting our patient-centric mission of empowering Canadians to take control of their health and well-being.

You will

  • Work closely with our medical directors and clinical operations team to manage and strategize for the medical pillar at Felix regarding the functionality of our healthcare practitioners.

  • Own file management: consolidate, update, and maintain electronic files and documents, including labs and referrals.

  • Help create and follow a robust system to track lab requisitions, ensuring all results and documentation are received in full. Follow an audit process to review requisitions from prior months and contact both labs and patients when results for tests ordered are not received.

  • Act as the liaison and support between the pharmacy and healthcare practitioner communications.

  • Schedule, manage, and support healthcare practitioners and patients with audio/video consultations.

  • Perform other related duties and tasks assigned by the clinical operations manager or medical director.

  • Work closely with the customer support team.

  • Help maintain clinical documentation and update training materials.

  • Assist with responding to faxes and voicemails from external stakeholders.

  • Perform a variety of administrative and data entry tasks to support our lab management processes.

  • Assist healthcare practitioners with document management and basic editing of medical and insurance forms.

  • Perform and be involved in QI/QA initiatives.

  • As a personal health information delegate, safeguard and protect personal health information.

You have

  • Must be located in Canada.

  • Must be available to work a set schedule of 5pm-1am EST (2pm-10pm PST), 5 days a week including weekends, 40 hours a week.

  • Must be available to work evenings and weekends as needed.

  • Successful completion of a medical office administration program or equivalent education in a related field.

  • Minimum 2+ years of experience working as a medical office professional.

  • Experience working in virtual care is considered an asset.

  • Technical aptitude and the ability to learn software and systems quickly, experience working with an EMR.

  • Strong organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.

  • Customer service experience is considered an asset.

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.

  • Ability to work both collaboratively and independently as we are a virtual-first company.

  • Fluent in English, bilingual in French is considered an asset.

  • Must have suitable remote-working environment where the safeguarding of personal health information can be facilitated

Benefits

  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits

  • Maternity/paternity policy

  • 3 weeks vacation

  • Stock option grant

About the Role

When a patient reaches out to Felix, you're often the most important person in their healthcare journey at that moment. This role is about more than closing tickets — it's about making sure people feel heard, get real answers, and leave the interaction better off than when they started.

You'll work primarily through chat and email, handling a meaningful volume of conversations each day. You'll need to think on your feet, navigate systems quickly, and resolve most issues without handing them off. It's a role with genuine ownership and genuine impact.

If you're someone who gets satisfaction from solving a hard problem well, who reads between the lines of what someone is asking, and who wants to build a career in a fast-moving, mission-driven environment — this is a strong fit.

  • Provide warm, attentive, and genuinely personalized support to Felix patients through chat and email

You Have

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Brand
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Felix

Founded in 2019, Felix is a digital healthcare company that puts the patient in control of their own health and wellbeing. We’re passionate about building technology and beautiful customer experiences to make healthcare more accessible (and more enjoyable) for all Canadians.

Felix is Canada's first end-to-end healthcare experience, providing online treatment, prescription delivery and ongoing care. We deliver care across a growing range of daily health categories such as weight loss, birth control, menopause, erectile dysfunction, acne, longevity and more.

Website: https://www.felixforyou.ca/

 

The Role

Millions of Canadians are waiting. Waiting for a family doctor, for a specialist, for a prescription refill, for someone to take their health seriously. Felix exists so they don't have to. Your job is to make sure every Canadian knows that, believes it, and chooses us.

This is one of the biggest brand jobs in Canada right now. You'll own the Felix brand and how we position and launch everything we build, at the moment Felix goes from fast-growing challenger to the name in Canadian healthcare. We're investing seriously in brand for the first time, across TV, digital, audio, out-of-home, social, PR and experiential, and we expect that investment to earn its keep: more Canadians who know us, trust us and choose us, and a performance engine that gets more efficient because the brand is working.

Be clear-eyed about one thing: this is a strategic seat and a very hands-on one. You personally own and drive our flagship integrated marketing campaigns (IMCs), end to end. You write or co-write the brief, run the agency, make the creative calls, build the plan, chase the dates, and land it in market on time and measured. You'll set the 18-month brand vision in the morning and be in the edit suite in the afternoon. If you want to direct from 30,000 feet and hand the work to others, this isn't your role. If you love being accountable for both the idea and the outcome, keep reading.

You'll also lead Product Marketing, including our Director, Product Marketing & Editorial, so the story we tell in a TV spot and the story a patient reads on our site, in their inbox and in the app is one story. Our next wave of product launches will be some of the most important in Canadian digital health. You'll decide how they look, sound and feel, and why someone chooses Felix.

You Will

  • Own and Drive Our Flagship IMCs, End to End: You are the accountable lead on our biggest brand moments of the year, including our January campaign, Canada's busiest season for health decisions. Write the inspiring brief, run the agency relationship, make the creative calls with conviction, partner with our Growth lead on ATL media plans, build the integrated plan across distribution channels, and rally cross-functional teams to land it in market on the date we set. Every IMC launches with a measurement plan agreed up front, and closes with an honest read on what worked.

  • Set the Brand Strategy and Calendar: Own an insight-driven brand strategy and an 18-month integrated marketing calendar that ladders up to the business plan, across categories and audiences. Make the hard choices on where we show up, where we don't, and why.

  • Have Product Marketing GTM roll up to you: We have an awesome Director rolling into you who owns the Product Marketing & Editorial function and go-to-market for our biggest product bets. Help support this individual to take product positioning from undifferentiated to unmistakable, starting with weight loss. Integrate product marketing elements into our Brand IMCs and partner with Product, Clinical and R&D so launches are timely, differentiated, and ready on day one across Dotcom, Lifecycle, Paid and Creative.

  • Make Brand Accountable to the Business: Own the brand budget and the numbers behind it. Track brand health (awareness, consideration, trust) alongside partnering with our Head of Growth on conversion and cost per acquisition. Partner with Growth, Creative, Marketing Analytics and Finance on brand lift, incrementality and media mix modelling, so brand investment is a decision we can defend, not a leap of faith.

  • Build Earned Reach and Cultural Relevance: Lead PR, influencer and creator programs, brand partnerships and experiential. Turn Felix data, patient stories and clinical expertise into moments that earn attention and trust.

  • Do Brave, Distinctive Work in a Regulated Category: Our category is crowded with brands saying the same thing. Push for creative that is emotionally resonant and unmistakably Felix, while working hand in hand with Compliance, Medical and Legal within Canada's rules on advertising health services and prescription treatments. Great constraints make great work.

  • Build and Lead a High-Performing Team: Lead, coach and grow the Brand & Product Marketing team (3 direct reports, 1 freelancer), and hire against the bets that matter. Set a high bar, give clear direction, and build an operating rhythm (planning, briefs, reviews, retros) that lets the team move fast at high quality without dropping things.

  • Operate as Connective Tissue: Work shoulder to shoulder with Growth Marketing, Lifecycle, Dotcom, Creative, Product, Clinical, Data, and CX. Be the person partners come to for an answer and leave with one, quickly.

  • Bring the Founders and Executive Team Along: Felix is a company that values healthy, respectful debate. Present clear recommendations, invite the stress test, and use it to make the work sharper.

You Are

  • A relentless integrated executor. You get net-new work off the ground, not just inherited workstreams across the line. Your plans arrive complete: owners, milestones, success metrics and a distribution plan, with compliance and production time built in. You hit your dates, and when something is at risk, you're the first to know and the first to re-plan.

  • Fluent in the business and the numbers. You know the numbers on your own work cold, and you can hold your own with Finance on budget, CAC and return on brand investment. You think like a general business manager, not only a marketer.

  • Energized by ambiguity and pace. You've built the plane while flying it before, and you enjoy it. Priorities shift, launches move, new categories appear, and you adapt fast without losing quality.

  • A people leader who wants to lead. You get real energy from building a team, coaching people through stretch work, and raising the bar on craft. Leading people is a core part of the job you want, not a tax on it.

  • Fast, responsive and on top of the flow. You keep up with a high volume of Slack, email and decisions without becoming the bottleneck so partners can work seamlessly.

  • A visionary with taste and conviction. You know the difference between work that's safe and work that moves people, and you can articulate why. You can tell an agency "not yet" and help them get to "yes." You naturally rally and inspire the internal organization with the possibilities.

  • Low-ego and collaborative, with a strong point of view. You welcome being challenged, change your mind with good evidence, and hold firm when the evidence is on your side.

You Have

  • 10+ years in brand marketing at consumer or DTC brands, with meaningful experience in product marketing or a role spanning both.

  • Experience at a tech startup or scale-up, ideally through a period of hypergrowth. You know what "fast" really means.

  • A track record of personally leading multi-million-dollar integrated campaigns across TV or online video, digital, audio, out-of-home, social and PR, as the accountable owner from brief to in-market. We'll ask you to walk us through the plan, the timeline and the results.

  • Experience working on lesser-known brands, understanding how the playbook differs for a brand at 10% aided awareness vs 80%.

  • Product marketing and GTM experience: positioning frameworks, launch plans, and partnering directly with Product and Engineering to ship.

  • Hands-on experience with brand measurement: brand tracking, brand lift studies, and working with incrementality testing or media mix modelling.

  • Deep experience collaborating with cross-functional teams like Product/Eng, Lifecycle, Website, Growth Marketing.

  • 5+ years managing teams, including senior individual contributors or managers, with people you can point to who grew under your leadership.

  • A portfolio and specific examples that show taste, judgment and results. We will ask to see the actual work, not just titles on a resume.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in healthcare, wellness, pharma, financial services or another highly regulated category, including close partnership with Compliance/Legal in finding ways forward.

  • Experience in the Canadian market.

  • Consumer subscription experience, understanding the power of retention/churn/reactivation.

  • A point of view on how AI is changing brand & creative production, content and discovery (GEO).

  • Experience building a brand from challenger to category leader.

  • Collaboration with in-house creative – delivering the strategy and briefs that generate career-best work and breakthrough design & concepts from that group.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you've read the results of our brand campaigns to date, and turned them into clear learnings. You've met every key partner across Marketing, Data, Product, Clinical and Compliance, and they already know you as the person who gets them answers. You're continuing momentum on our next flagship IMC, with a plan, timeline and measurement approach the founders have signed off on, empowering our creatives and agency partners to dream big, and deliver.

In your first year, you've landed at least 1-2 IMCs on time and on budget. Felix is closer to being the most-known name in Canadian digital health, and we can show brand investment making performance marketing more efficient. Along the way, you’ve led the way in developing a clear POV on how Brand strategically fits into our overall business growth story internally, and worked with the CMO and CFO on how we should think about measurement and ROI of brand tactics. Our biggest launches have a sharp, differentiated story, live across every surface on day one. And your team is stronger, clearer and more ambitious than when you arrived.

Benefits

  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits

  • Maternity / paternity policy

  • 4 weeks vacation (3 weeks anytime + 1 week during the holidays)

  • Competitive compensation and stock option grant

  • Remote first, work from anywhere in Canada - with optional office in downtown Toronto

  • Large impact at an inflection-point company, working closely with founders and leadership on one of the most important mandates in Canadian healthcare

Website: https://www.felixforyou.ca/

The Role

We're looking for an experienced people manager to lead our fast-growing Medical Office

Assistant (MOA) team. The team is the first point of contact for our healthcare providers on

platform and workflow questions, and supports patients and healthcare providers 7 days a week across lab results and follow-ups, referrals, insurance forms and records, prescription and pharmacy queries. We also help our healthcare providers with vacation coverage, patient reassignments and payouts.

You’ll directly manage members of the MOA team and coach and develop our Team Leads and Senior MOAs. People leadership

  • Manage escalations from patients, healthcare providers and partner teams

  • Share evening and weekend leadership coverage

  • Analyze metrics to understand trends and measure the impact of changes and launches

  • Keep SOPs and the knowledge base current, and make sure patient privacy and documentation standards are followed in every workflow

  • Perform other related duties as assigned by the leadership team

  • Experience managing and developing team leads or supervisors, including performance management

  • Data-driven: comfortable analyzing data in Google Sheets or Excel and building simple dashboards to make and explain decisions

  • Strong understanding of patient privacy (PHIPA / PIPEDA) and handling of personal health information

  • Experience working cross-functionally with clinical, product and data teams

  • Effective communicator who stays calm and organized under pressure

  • Ability to work both collaboratively and independently, as we are a virtual-first company

  • MOA, medical office or clinical background, including lab, insurance form or pharmacy workflows

  • Experience at a startup or scale-up, ideally in telehealth or healthcare

  • Experience managing remote or virtual teams

  • Experience supporting product launches or new workflow rollouts

  • Leading virtual medicine provider in Canada: work at the cutting edge of virtual healthcare
